name: Income War Map Revenue Planning
problem: A person needs a structured revenue plan based on their real constraints rather than generic opportunity lists.
use_when: side hustle ideas for my situation
how can I increase my income
inputs: User-provided income, expenses, debt, skills, available time, risk tolerance, work context, location and revenue target.
outputs: Personalized planning opportunities, modeled revenue/startup/time/risk estimates, prioritized missions and progress tracking.
pricing: Planned tiers exist, but new membership checkout is currently paused while entitlement synchronization is hardened.
confirmation: Planning estimates are not guarantees or individualized investment, tax, legal or credit advice. No checkout should be initiated while billing is paused.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability only. Paid membership checkout is disabled pending entitlement hardening.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
